items.title: Towards Scalable RLVR: Multimodal Instruction Following Data Synthesis and Distillation
items.summary:
arXiv:2609.16059v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal instruction following (MMIF) is crucial for building generalist agents. However, current training paradigms rely heavily on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), which often leads to surface-level pattern matching and degrades general capabilities. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising alternative, its scalability in MMIF is severely bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality, RL-ready multimodal data.
